title: Conditional re-estimation trigger
goal: check:freshness asks for a re-estimation of open steps when closed steps show a sustained gap between estimate and actual
acceptance: Settings `estimation.minSamples` (default 5 closed steps since the last calibration), `estimation.ratio` (default 1.5: median actual/baseline above 1.5 or below 0.67) and `estimation.outlier` (default 3: any single step 3x off)
The finding names the group and the open steps to re-estimate; the agent revises `days` with a dated basis citing the calibration, keeping `baselineDays`
A material effort increase still goes to the owner (Optional upfront feature plans)
`estimation.lastCalibrated` records when re-estimation was done so the same samples do not re-trigger
privacy: Metadata only: estimates, dates, durations and task identities; no prompts, transcripts or personal data.
validation: Fixtures: below threshold silent, ratio trigger, outlier trigger, reset after calibration
escalation: Default thresholds are an owner decision; the defaults above are a proposal

effort.basis: Same shape as the existing audit-age and backlog-behind findings in check:freshness. Implemented 2026-11-11 in one branch with F-053–F-055; review and release remain. Estimate, not a measurement.
